description: A book club by its link. Suits "what's this club link?", "what are we reading?", "when do we meet?" and "what's on the ballot?". Anyone gets the club's public preview, and a linked member also gets the current read, next meeting, open poll and the host's pinned message. It never returns chat messages or other members' names.
